correctness.rationale: The exact source generator yields 32 additive words with the published distribution 1+21z^5+7z^6+3z^7. All 21 minimum words have distinct two-coordinate zero sets, exhausting all pairs. This incidence forces local symbol maps from a coordinate permutation. Exhaustion of all 7! permutations plus direct action on all 32 words gives exactly 21 full equivalence automorphisms and 7 pure coordinate automorphisms; closure and the exact element-order census identify the group as the nonabelian C7 semidirect C3.

value.rationale: The source isolates this as the unique additive code at an extremal length-seven parameter and calls out cyclicity. The full stabilizer under exactly that equivalence is a natural classification invariant: it shows two-thirds of the symmetries are invisible from pure cyclic shifts. The all-pairs zero-set incidence supplies structural content useful for recognizing equivalent representatives, so the result is not a routine parameter recomputation.
